use: every shader measurement; the JVM track's reference runtime

runtime.buildWhy: latest Temurin 25 GA on 2026-10-06 (Adoptium API, release jdk-25.0.4.1+1, 2026-08-19); pinned in the Phase -1 spike with its archive sha256
runtime.source: Adoptium API (api.adoptium.net); install checks the archive sha256 and unpacks it under runtime/java/
runtime.imageType: jdk (javap and jcmd are used by the spike and the harness)

heap.sizeWhy: provisional 6144 MiB (the spike launches with it and checks the started process against it); the spike records an idle lower bound, and M2 sets the size from the heap after GC over a full-mode session with its reloads, plus headroom. Xms = Xmx removes heap resizing from the measurement

flagsWhy: plain and reproducible (user, 2026-10-05); GPU-bound shader scenes barely react to JVM flags; tuning belongs to the JVM track
check: the harness reads the started process's real arguments and refuses a mismatch (ALC practice)
